sentences.text: In the unplanned grandmaster failover scenario (B_unplanned_failover) the frozen rule returned UNKNOWN in 12 of 12 campaign runs.

In that scenario GM-A is killed with no maintenance window open and the provisioned GM-B takes over; the scenario script notes that from packets alone this is indistinguishable from an attack that suppressed GM-A.

From packets alone this is INDISTINGUISHABLE from an attack that suppressed GM-A; ... manifest benign B_UNPLANNED false "UNPLANNED: GM-A crashes, NO maintenance window; GM-B (provisioned) elected" ... kill -9 $(cat $OUT/gma.pid)

sentences.text: In this app's replay, capture frames are attributed to senders by source MAC address, not by bridge ingress port; in A2, A3, A5, C2 and C3, frames from unprovisioned MACs, GM MACs on brDN and master-role frames from RU3's MAC are counted as the injector, and in A1 and A8 the rogue devices' MACs are mapped to the rogue grandmaster and rogue boundary clock.
sentences.quote: dev = macmap.get(m_, "unknown"); if ctx["scenario"] in ("A2_sync_spoof", "A3_replay", "C2_malformed", "C3_wholesecond", "A5_dos_flood") and (dev in ("unknown", "flooder") or (dev == "ru3" and ty in MASTER_TYPES) or (seg == "dn" and dev in ("gma", "gmb"))): dev = "injector"; A1: macmap[mac(P_["rogue_mac"])] = "rogue"; A8: macmap[mac(P_["rbc_dn_mac"])] = "rbc"; macmap[mac(P_["rbc_up_mac"])] = "rbc"

sentences.text: Isolation requires at least 2 of the last 3 evaluations to say ATTACK; a provisioned master-role port is never isolated automatically; the service-loss trigger is no Announce from any provisioned master port for 2 s (10 s while a maintenance window is open).
sentences.quote: | Persistence | ≥ 2 of the last 3 evaluations ATTACK | Single-window transients cannot trigger an action | ... | Service-loss trigger | no Announce from any provisioned master port for 2 s; 10 s while a maintenance window is open | ... | Safety guard | a master-role provisioned port (primary BC, standby BC, planned replacement BC) is never isolated automatically |
